tasks.label: C/C++: prepare source list
args: $files = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath '${workspaceFolder}' -Filter '*.cpp' -File); if ($files.Count -eq 0) { Write-Error 'No .cpp files found.'; exit 1 }; $lines = foreach ($f in $files) { '"' + $f.FullName + '"' }; $rsp = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'vscode_cpp_sources.rsp'; [System.IO.File]::WriteAllLines($rsp, $lines, [System.Text.Encoding]::ASCII)

tasks.label: C/C++: g++.exe build active file
tasks.detail: Build all C++ source files in the project.
